args.prompt: Game character turnaround reference. The mage stands perfectly still in a neutral idle pose on an invisible turntable and rotates a full 360 degrees at a constant speed, turning to show their left side, then their back, then their right side, then front again. Locked-off camera, slightly elevated looking down, no camera movement, no zoom, no perspective change. Plain flat white background, even soft lighting. The design stays exactly identical: deep blue hooded robe with gold trim, face half shadowed by the hood, brown leather belt with pouches, brown boots. No flashing, glowing or pulsing light: the cyan crystal keeps exactly the same brightness and colour in every frame, no glow, no halo. Crisp sharp detail in every frame, no motion blur, no ghosting, no walking, no text.

Game sprite walk cycle. The mage walks in place on a treadmill, keeping exactly the facing direction of the first frame (facing the camera). Holding exactly the body angle of the first frame: torso does not twist. Steady marching walk: legs alternating clearly, slight body bob, staff held upright in their right hand, robe hem swaying. Props stay where the first frame has them: wooden staff topped with a cyan crystal in their right hand (on the image-left side). The mage stays exactly centered, does not turn, move or change size. Locked-off camera, no zoom, plain flat white background, even lighting, crisp frames, no motion blur. Two full steps, loops seamlessly back to the starting pose.

Nearly static game sprite idle loop. The mage holds exactly the pose, angle and facing of the first frame (facing the camera) for the whole clip. Only a very small breathing motion: chest and shoulders rise and fall by a few pixels, robe hem moves very slightly. Staff stay completely still, arms do not move, body does not turn, feet do not move, head does not turn. No flashing, glowing or pulsing light: the cyan crystal keeps exactly the same brightness and colour in every frame, no glow, no halo. Locked camera, no zoom, plain flat white background, even lighting, crisp frames.
